title: Order Event Resubmission
description: The request with which an Integration Team member resubmits a Set-Aside Order Event (UC-008 step 1). Trailhead Gear owns it, so it allows no other field.

eventId.description: Event id of the Set-Aside Order Event; it must still be kept (UC-008 A1, BR-003).

correctedEvent.description: The Order Event with the content that could not be read corrected (UC-008 BR-002); absent when the Order Event is resubmitted unchanged. Its `event_id` must be the `eventId` of the request, which is checked when it is resubmitted. Holds personal data (C-021).
